Name: BILLING
Description: Customer bills: one row per bill with charges, tax and payment status.

Name: BILL_AMOUNT
Description: Total billed amount before tax, in USD.

Name: PAYMENT_STATUS
Description: Payment state of the bill: Paid, Pending or Overdue.

Name: DUE_DATE
Description: Date by which the bill must be paid.

Name: CUSTOMER
Description: Customer master record, one row per customer account.

Name: CUSTOMER_NAME
Description: Legal name of the customer or business.

Name: CREDIT_SCORE
Description: Internal credit score from the credit-risk model.

Name: METER_READING
Description: Interval and register meter reads, one row per meter per read date.

Name: CONSUMPTION_KWH
Description: Energy consumed in the read period (kWh).

Name: Bill Amount
Definition: The amount charged to a customer for energy and demand in a billing period, excluding tax.

Name: Peak Demand KW
Definition: Highest 15-minute average demand in the period (kW).

Name: Customer Segment
Definition: Classification of a customer as Residential, Commercial or Industrial for tariff and reporting purposes.

Name: Customer Billing
Definition: Billing and revenue data of retail customers.
